I used the released product **DAILY_INVOICED_SALES**, version **101**. The object queried was `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.L2P_RELEASE.DAILY_INVOICED_SALES_V0101`. It covers invoices from 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03 and is SYNTHETIC Northstar Supply data.

**Top 5 customers for account review, ranked by invoiced sales excluding tax**

| Rank | Customer | ID | Sales excl. tax | Invoice lines | Distinct items | Active days | First invoice | Last invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fictional Customer 010 | 10 | 4,964.45 | 17 | 11 | 7 | 2026-01-05 | 2026-02-22 |
| 2 | Fictional Customer 008 | 8 | 4,719.06 | 22 | 13 | 7 | 2026-01-11 | 2026-03-03 |
| 3 | Fictional Customer 019 | 19 | 4,297.74 | 16 | 11 | 6 | 2026-01-08 | 2026-02-21 |
| 4 | Fictional Customer 018 | 18 | 4,072.60 | 18 | 10 | 8 | 2026-01-08 | 2026-02-26 |
| 5 | Fictional Customer 004 | 4 | 3,756.35 | 22 | 12 | 9 | 2026-01-06 | 2026-02-21 |

Sales excluding tax is the invoice extended price minus the tax amount. The product doesn't record a currency, so no currency is shown.

**Notes**
- The top five are close together: there are 1,208.10 between #1 and #5.
- Customer 008 was invoiced most recently (2026-03-03) and bought the widest range of items (13).
- Customer 004 had the most active days (9) but the lowest total of the five.

**What this data can and can't show**
This ranking is based only on invoiced sales. The product has no data on marketing consent, campaign response, margin or causal uplift. It also doesn't track returns or discounts. So this shortlist can't tell you:
- whether a customer may be contacted
- how they would respond to a campaign
- how profitable they are
- what effect a review or campaign would have

It only shows which accounts had the highest invoiced sales in this period, which makes them reasonable places to start an account review.
